correctness.rationale: PASS: Q is the capped-sum cube section L<=y_i<=U; the clipped projection y_i=clip(i+lambda,L,U) satisfies the variational normal-cone inequality and is unique (strict convexity). All P vertices have equal projection distance by S_n symmetry, and convexity bounds all interior points. Equality in squared norm convexity forces equal residual vectors; strictly separated clipped tails and constant unclipped middle produce precisely n!/m! disjoint exposed faces, each dimension m-1, with translate-by-residual nearest points. Riemann-sum capped balance yields two beta regimes and a C2-not-C3 quarter-density formula; special beta=0 limiting case argued separately. Reconstructed rational clipping for all 3<=n<=11, full residual classes for 3<=n<=7 and symbolic derivatives; finite checks do not establish all dimensions.
